Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Satish Kumar Mishra Hon'ble Rajeev Misra,J. 
Ref: Impleadment Application Heard Mr. Diwakar Tiwari, the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State/opposite party-1 and Mr. Satish Kumar Mishra, the learned counsel representing the victim/proposed opposite party-5.
Perused the record.

This impleadent application has been filed by applicant-Saunu Rathi Alias Bhola to implead the victim of Case Crime No. 131 of 2021, under Section 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act,
Police Station- Chandaus, District- Aligarh as opposite party-5.

sentences.text: Perused the affidavit filed in support of impleadment application.

Having heard the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State, Mr. Arpit Mishra, the learned counsel for first informant and upon perusal of affidavit filed in support of impleadment application, this Court finds considering the nature gravity of offence involved and also the subsequent developments that have taken place, the impleadment prayed for by applicant is bonafide.
The same is also necessary for just and effective adjudication of present application.
Learned A.G.A. representing opposite party-1 does not oppose this impleadment application.
Accordingly the impleadment application is allowed.
The victim shall now be impleaded as opposite party-5 in the present application.
The necessary amendment in the cause tile of this application shall be undertaken by the learned counsel for applicant during course of the day.

Ref: On Application Heard Mr. Diwakar Tiwari, the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State/opposite party-1 and Mr. Satish Kumar Mishra, the learned counsel representing victim/opposite party-5.
Perused the record.
At the very outset, the learned A.G.A. submits that notice of this application has been served upon first informant/opposite party-2 on 19.8.2024.

However, inspite of service of notice, neither any counter affidavit has been filed by first informant/opposite party-2 nor anyone has put in appearance on his behalf to oppose this application even in revised call.

This application under section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by accused applicant Saunu Rathi Alias Bhola with the following prayer:
"It is, therefore Most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow this application and quash the entire criminal proceeding including the impugned charge sheet dated 24.12.2022 as well as cognizance/ Summoning order dated 04.03.2024 passed by Ld. Special Judge (POCSO) Act/Additional District and Sessions Judge, Aligarh in Session Trial No. 323 of 2024 (State Vs.
Saunu Rathi @ Bhola and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 0131 of 2021, under section 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and section 3/4 of (POCSO) Act, Police Station-Chandaus, District-Aligarh, pending in the court of Ld. Special Judge,
(POCSO) Act/Additional District and Sessions Judge, Aligarh.
It is, further, be prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to stay the further proceeding of Case Crime No. 0131 of 2021, under section 363, 366, 376 I.P.C.
and section 3/4 of (POCSO) Act, Police Station-Chandaus, District-Aligarh, pending in the court of Ld. Special Judge, (POCSO) Act/Additional District and Sessions Saunu Rathi Alias Bhola vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69779006/
2 Judge, Aligarh, pending in the court of Special Judge, (POCSO) Act/Additional District and Sessions Judge, Aligarh, otherwise the Applicant shall suffer irreparable loss and injury.
And/or may pass such other and further order which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case."
Learned counsel for applicant submits that subsequent to the F.I.R. dated 22.7.2021, lodged by first informant/opposite party-2, giving rise to present criminal proceedings, the prosecutrix has solemnized marriage with the applicant on 31.10.2022.

sentences.text: Consequently, the prosecutrix is now the legally wedded wife of applicant.
In view of above, the prosecutrix is living with the applicant as his legally wedded wife.
From the aforesaid wedlock two children were born.
The marriage of the parties has also been registered under the provisions of U.P. Marriage Registration Rules, 2017.
Copy of marriage registration certificate has been brought on record as Annexure-11 to the affidavit filed in support of present application.
On the above premise, the learned counsel for applicant submits that in view of the subsequent developments the criminality if any committed by applicant now stands washed of.
As such, no good ground exists to prolong the prosecution of applicant.
In case the criminal prosecution of applicant is allowed to continue, a happy family shall stand broken.
He, therefore contends that present application is liable to be allowed.
Per contra the learned A.G.A. for opposite party-1 has opposed the present application.

Learned A.G.A. submits that since the prosecutrix was a child within the meaning of the term child as defined under the POCSO Act, therefore, the subsequent development if any will not wipe out the criminality committed by applicant.
As such, no indulgence be granted by his Court in favour of applicant.
However, he could not dislodge the factual and legal submissions urged by the learned counsel for applicant with reference to the record at this stage.
Mr. Satish Kumar Mishra, the learned counsel for prosecutrix/victim submits that he has been instructed not to oppose the present application.
According to the learned counsel representing the victim, it is now an admitted fact that prosecutrix has solemnized marriage with applicant.
Out of the said wedlock, two children were born.
The prosecutrix has been residing with the applicant as his legally wedded wife.
In view of above, the prosecutrix has no objection, in case present application is allowed by this Court.

Having heard the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State/opposite party-1 and Mr. Satish Kumar Mishra, the learned counsel representing first informant/opposite party-2 and upon perusal of record this Court finds that subsequent to the F.I.R. dated 22.7.2021 lodged by first informant/opposite party-2, the prosecutrix victim has solemnized marriage with the applicant.
As such, prosecutrix/victim is now the legally wedded wife of applicant.
Resultantly the prosecutrix/victim is residing with the applicant as his legally wedded wife.
From the aforesaid wedlock, two children were born.
The bonafide of the parties is further explicit from the record that the marriage of the parties has been registered under the provisions of the U.P. Registration of Marringe Rules, 2017.
As such, there is statutorily presumption regarding illegality of the marriage of the parties.

In view of the subsequent developments as noted herein above, the criminality if any Saunu Rathi Alias Bhola vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69779006/
3 committed by applicant now stands washed of.
